name: comp-295
title: Social Mention Notification
blurb: Social mention notification with avatar, name, and accept/decline buttons.
description: Static social mention notification with user avatar, linked names for person and project, timestamp, accept/decline buttons, and dismissible close.
use_when: You need to notify about social mentions or project collaborations with user context.
avoid_when: For direct messages or system alerts; use a dedicated messaging system instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label. Links are keyboard accessible. No motion or animation.
